Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As a Cyber & AI Risk Analyst, you will play a critical role in strengthening Alpaca’s security, compliance, and AI risk posture across the organization. Reporting to the Cyber GRC Lead, you will support the identification, assessment, and documentation of cybersecurity and AI-related risks that impact our infrastructure, products, trading systems, and internal operations.

You will contribute to the design and execution of our risk management framework across traditional cyber domains (cloud security, infrastructure, application security, third-party risk, regulatory compliance) while also helping establish foundational governance controls for AI systems, models, and AI-enabled product features.

This role sits at the intersection of cybersecurity, emerging AI governance, regulatory expectations, and financial services risk management. You’ll collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, and IT teams to ensure Alpaca remains resilient, compliant, and forward-looking in how we manage both Cyber and AI risk.

We’re looking for someone curious, organized, and eager to grow. If you enjoy learning how technical systems work, translating risk into clear language, and building structured programs from the ground up, then this role is for you. Prior GRC experience is a plus, but not required; we’re happy to invest in the right candidate.

jobs.title: Hands-on Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Location: 100% remote (EMEA)

Classification: Full-time

Pay Range: 82.000€ to 140.000€ - determined by several factors, including location

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on:

We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers.

What’s unique about management at Miaplaza:

Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice:

  1. You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important.

  2. We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer.

  3. We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you.

  4. One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports' work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output.

  5. Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader, of which:

    • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering, of which:

  • 3+ years running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE preferred)

  • 3+ years of experience with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code. GCP is our primary cloud and we expect senior-level knowledge of IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, CloudSQL and Secret Manager

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operations

  • Experience with GitOps (FluxCD or ArgoCD)

  • Experience working directly with engineering teams and other managers as your customers on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience leading incident response, including running postmortems

What makes you stand out:

Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

Experience with consumer platforms at scale

Experience building in regulated environments

Experience operating self-hosted observability stacks (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry)

Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling

Experience supporting .NET/C# application deployments

Experience with database operations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ)

Experience with Istio or other service meshes

Responsibilities

  • Work with your team to design, build, and operate the infrastructure the rest of engineering depends on: clusters, pipelines, databases, edge, and observability

  • Your customers are the other engineering teams. Work with the other Engineering Managers and product development leadership to scope and prioritize platform work

  • Set the quality bar for your team. Lead by example.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean infrastructure-as-code, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

  • Application and CV Review - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update.

  • Initial Technical Screen (20 minutes) - A quick screening call to answer some administrative questions and confirm your basic technical knowledge. You'll be asked some administrative questions and 7 short technical questions related to the role.

  • Behavioral Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of our HR team to discuss your experience and share your approach throughout your career so far.

  • 1st Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team to answer focused technical questions tailored to our work.

  • Scenario-based Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team and the team's engineering manager to work through two hypothetical DevOps scenarios and how you would tackle them.

  • Leadership Interview (1 hour) - With our head of engineering and executive leadership.

  • Reference check - We'll reach out to the 3 references you provided, at least one being a former or current manager and any former or current direct reports.

  • Offer & background check - Once you sign your offer, we'll run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation and setup

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area.

Miaplaza is a growing, self-funded EdTech company. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

jobs.title: Remote Cybersecurity Consultant
jobs.description:
Category: IT Services

Location:


This is a hands-on role. We are not looking for someone to only advise us and leave the work to our team: you will do a large part of the security work yourself, working inside our repositories, pipelines and cloud accounts alongside our engineers. You will configure tools, fix and harden things, write the processes and documents, and run the sessions, while showing our team how it is done along the way.

Our goal is a company that runs a secure development lifecycle on every project, has its own house in order, is well on the way to ISO/IEC 27001 certification, and has an internal Security Lead who can work with you and gradually take over day-to-day ownership. This is a part-time role.

Responsibilities

Assessment and governance

  • Run the security maturity assessment yourself (for example OWASP SAMM), review our repositories, pipelines and cloud setup, and turn the findings into a prioritized roadmap.
  • Write our core security policies and procedures: access control, acceptable use, secure development, incident response, vendor and AI tool usage.
  • Set up and maintain the security backlog, risk register and progress metrics, and report progress to management monthly.

Company security ("secure the house")

  • Configure and enforce SSO and MFA across email, Git hosting, cloud consoles, CI/CD and Passbolt.
  • Review and fix access rights, and set up onboarding and offboarding checklists.
  • Harden our Passbolt setup and implement a secrets manager for applications and pipelines, including migrating existing secrets out of code and CI variables.
  • Implement baseline hardening for laptops, cloud accounts, backups and logging.
  • Write the incident response plan and run tabletop exercises with the team.

Secure software development

  • Build our standard Secure SDLC, based on OWASP ASVS and OWASP SAMM, and roll it out on real client projects.
  • Configure and tune our SecOps platform: reduce false positives, set up pipeline quality gates and triage findings together with the teams.
  • Add the missing scanning to our CI/CD pipelines yourself: SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, IaC and container scanning, DAST and SBOM generation.
  • Run threat modeling sessions on active projects and document the results.
  • Do security code reviews of high-risk changes and help developers fix vulnerabilities.
  • Perform internal security testing of our applications before releases, and scope and coordinate external penetration tests.

Regulation and compliance

  • Map how the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2 and relevant local regulations affect us and our clients.
  • Write and implement our vulnerability handling and disclosure process, including support for clients' CRA reporting obligations.
  • Do the hands-on ISO/IEC 27001 preparation work: scope, risk assessment, Statement of Applicability, policies and evidence, and work with the certification body.

Client offering

  • Help define security service tiers we can include in client proposals.
  • Fill in client security questionnaires and build a reusable answer set.
  • Join selected client meetings or calls as a senior security voice when needed.

People and knowledge

  • Work side by side with our internal Security Lead so they learn by doing.
  • Run short internal workshops on key topics (for example OWASP Top 10, threat modeling, secure CI/CD).
  • Recommend training and certification paths for developers, Security Champions and DevOps engineers.

Requirements

Must have

  • 8+ years of experience in information security, with recent hands-on work in application security, DevSecOps or cloud security.
  • Comfortable doing the work yourself: configuring security tools, writing pipeline configuration, reviewing code, testing applications and writing policies.

jobs.title: Recruiter
jobs.description:
YAMU Media is looking for a Talent Recruiter located outside of the United States to join our team. The role is open to people located in Latin America, Asia or Africa.

Job title: Recruiter

Job Overview

YAMU Media is a performance marketing agency working with B2B SaaS, ecommerce, and local businesses across the US market. We are a remote-first team of people who move fast, hold high standards, and care about building something worth working at.

We are looking for a mid-level recruiter to own hiring execution across YAMU. This is not a coordinator role. You will be the person who sources, screens, and moves candidates through the process with structure and speed, reporting directly to the Head of People. You will typically work across three to four open roles at once, all within marketing and paid media. You are the one who protects the pipeline by making sure only candidates who actually meet the bar get to the hiring manager, and that every candidate who touches YAMU leaves with a good impression of us, regardless of outcome.

Key Responsibilities

You will own sourcing across platforms including LinkedIn, Upwork, and our ATS, running both inbound screening and outbound outreach depending on the role. You will conduct screening calls that go beyond logistics: your job is to gather the information the hiring manager actually needs, flag misalignments early, and make a clear recommendation. You will coordinate technical tests and schedule interviews, making sure every step of the process is clean and no candidate falls through the cracks.

A big part of this role is calibration. You will work closely with the hiring manager to understand what each role actually requires, and you will make sure every candidate you advance has been evaluated against the full job description and the technical expectations set by the hiring manager. You will not pass someone through because they seemed nice. You will not advance someone because they interviewed well but can't do the work.

You will also take candidate experience seriously. That means timely updates, clear communication about next steps, and closing every candidate loop, including the ones who don't move forward. You will track pipeline activity and report on the status of open roles so that leadership always has visibility without having to ask.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of total recruiting experience, with a minimum of 2 years focused on marketing, paid media, or digital agency roles
  • Experience hiring for the US market, with international recruiting exposure in Latam, Asia, or Africa
  • Familiarity with AI tools used in recruiting workflows (HireEZ, SeekOut, ChatGPT/Claude for sourcing and screening support, AI-assisted ATS features)
  • Prior experience working in a startup environment, comfortable with fast-paced, evolving priorities
  • Demonstrated experience in end-to-end recruitment, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer management.
  • Strong skills in candidate sourcing through job boards, social platforms, networking, boolean search, and talent pipeline development.
  • Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), recruitment CRMs, and basic analytics or reporting tools. (BullHorn, Ashby, Greenhouse, Workable or any ATS)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to conduct structured, unbiased interviews.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple requisitions, and prioritize effectively.
  • Familiarity with SaaS, digital marketing, or tech-enabled service environments is highly beneficial.
  • Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and experience implementing fair, non-discriminatory hiring practices.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Your Attributes

You have a structured process and you follow it. You do not wait to be told something is wrong. If you notice a gap between what a hiring manager is asking for and the candidates coming in, you flag it before it becomes a problem. You are thorough without being slow. You know the difference between screening and selling, and you do not oversell roles to candidates in order to keep the pipeline full.

You are genuinely curious about people. You ask follow-up questions when an answer feels thin, and you know the difference between a real example and a framework answer. You take candidate experience personally because you understand that every interaction with a candidate is a reflection of the company you represent.

You are comfortable working across multiple roles at once without losing the thread on any of them. You do not need a lot of oversight to stay organized, but you communicate proactively and keep the people you report to informed.

We Offer You

Salary: discussable based on experience. Salaries at YAMU are uncapped and are periodically reviewed and increased based on performance and market conditions.

You will work directly at a remote-first company that moves fast and values doing things right.

This is a role where you will see the full picture of how a high-performance team gets built, and your work will have a direct impact on the quality of every team we grow.

Become part of a team of smart, open-minded people with individual qualities

You'll be a part of a rapidly growing company, with plentiful opportunities to grow into leadership roles. And you'll face a steep learning curve & daily data science, technological, and business challenges.

Work-Life Balance:We understand the importance of balancing work with personal life and offer supportive, flexible work arrangements to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Yamu Media provides a start-up environment and culture; fast-paced and agile with quick decision-making. It's an honest and open environment where team members at all levels can make a difference and have a say.

We believe in life-long learning and supporting the development of our team. We are committed to internal promotions, offering clear pathways for advancements as your skills are developed and experience is gained.

About YAMU

YAMU Media is a US-based demand-generation agency. We work with B2B SaaS companies, ecommerce brands, and local businesses from $1M to $20M ARR. Our services include paid media, SEO, CRO, email marketing, and web development. We are fully remote and operate on EST hours.

This is a remote position.

Advise an early-stage women's health venture on sensor selection and hardware feasibility for a wearable device, helping the founding team make sound technical decisions before committing to a prototype build.

Organization: Confidential — early-stage women's health venture
Location: Remote, open to candidates across the SWANA region; Palestinian talent is welcome
Role Type: Flexible, part-time advisory contract, initially month-to-month
Reports to: The venture's founders

The opportunity

Our client, an early-stage women's health venture, has a defined concept and written description for a sensor-based wearable and is seeking experienced technical guidance before moving into hardware development. The founders — whose team includes a midwife — will continue to drive the research and day-to-day development themselves; they need an advisor who can stress-test the concept, flag feasibility gaps, and help translate a promising idea into a realistic, buildable hardware specification. This is a flexible, part-time advisory role: discussions, reviews and occasional focused technical contributions, with the possibility of a larger role as the venture and the relationship develop.

About the organization

Our client is an early-stage, founder-funded venture building products for women's health, working on several in parallel. The founding team includes a midwife, which grounds the venture's clinical thinking in direct frontline experience. For the sensor-based wearable at the center of this role, the founders have already worked out a concept and a written description of how it could work, and are now looking for the technical judgement to pressure-test that thinking before resources go into building hardware.

What you will do
  • Review the wearable concept and proposed measurement methods, assess technical feasibility, and flag gaps or incorrect assumptions
  • Recommend suitable sensors and components, and explain alternative approaches to achieving the required measurements
  • Advise on design choices that could make the wearable smaller, simpler, or more effective
  • Help translate the concept into clear technical specifications, including small pieces of documentation or other focused technical work when agreed
  • Discuss progress, help guide development milestones, and help prioritize useful research or exploratory work
  • Explain recommendations and trade-offs clearly to founders who do not have an engineering background
  • Identify questions that need deeper specialist input and suggest where to seek that expertise

What you bring
  • Practical experience in hardware engineering and sensors, with enough technical depth to provide useful, well-founded advice
  • Understanding of sensor selection, component choices, and how sensing hardware fits into a complete device
  • Broad awareness of what is involved in building a wearable, and the judgement to recognize when additional specialist input is needed
  • Clear communication in English, with the ability to explain technical ideas, discuss assumptions, and collaborate constructively with non-technical founders
  • Availability for the agreed advisory hours, with some overlap around European lunchtime or evening

Senior experience is helpful, but earlier-career engineers who can demonstrate strong, directly relevant experience and the ability to advise within their area of expertise are also welcome — there is no fixed requirement for a particular number of years.

Helpful, but not essential
  • Experience developing wearables or compact sensor-based devices (transferable experience from other hardware products is also welcome)
  • Relevant experience with optical sensing, including infrared or blue light, or with flow, temperature, pressure, or density measurement
  • Experience in health technology, or an interest in women's health and the problems the venture is working to address

How the engagement works

Compensation is an hourly rate, with the initial allocation agreed based on relevant expertise and scope. This is initially a small, flexible advisory engagement that can fit alongside other work; the monthly allocation, or use of an agreed block of hours, will be arranged with the selected advisor. With mutual interest and as the venture develops, there may be scope for a larger commitment or future discussions about a technical co-founder or CTO role; any expansion would be agreed separately. You will need your own laptop, reliable connectivity, a secure work environment and two-factor authentication where required.

Apricot is a nonprofit sourcing firm connecting displaced and underserved professionals from Palestine and the wider MENA region with global employment opportunities. We combine a clear social-impact mission with fast, high-quality recruitment delivery for international clients.

jobs.title: Internal Support Engineer
jobs.description:
About Nerdio

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

Our Internal Support Team keeps Nerdio running — maintaining the corporate infrastructure, endpoints, identity systems, and collaboration tools that every employee depends on. This is a team that takes pride in operational excellence and getting things right.

About the role

We are hiring an experienced IT Support Engineer to join our Internal Support Team in the EMEA region. This role is ideal for someone who has been in the field for several years and is ready to work in a fast-paced, cloud-first environment that actually uses the products and technologies they support.

You will be the first point of contact for internal employees across the organization, handling tickets, resolving endpoint and identity issues, onboarding and offboarding users, and contributing to the ongoing health of our corporate environment. You will work closely with a tight-knit IT team and have direct exposure to both on-premises and cloud infrastructure.

This is not a passive help desk role. We expect you to ask questions, build knowledge, document what you learn, and grow into a more senior contributor over time.

What you'll do

End-User Support & Ticketing

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for internal support tickets via Zendesk
  • Triage, prioritize, and resolve hardware, software, and access issues for a globally distributed employee base
  • Escalate complex issues appropriately while owning the communication back to the end user
  • Document resolutions and contribute to the internal knowledge base

Identity & Access Management

  • Administer user accounts, groups, and permissions in Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory)
  • Manage on-premises Active Directory and support synchronization to Entra via the Entra Connect Sync tool
  • Handle user lifecycle events including onboarding, offboarding, and role changes across all connected systems
  • Enforce and troubleshoot Conditional Access policies, MFA enrollment, and SSO configurations

Endpoint Management

  • Manage and support Windows and macOS endpoints via Microsoft Intune (Endpoint Manager)
  • Handle device enrollment, compliance policy enforcement, configuration profiles, and app deployment
  • Support remote employees with device troubleshooting across a variety of hardware

Microsoft 365 Administration

  • Administer core M365 workloads including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive
  • Manage mailboxes, distribution lists, shared mailboxes, and Teams workspace provisioning
  • Support license assignment and M365 service configurations

Nerdio Manager for MSP

  • Support and administer internal use of Nerdio Manager for MSP as part of the corporate toolset
  • Assist with Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environments managed through Nerdio, including troubleshooting user session issues
  • Gain familiarity with Nerdio's product suite as both a user and internal subject matter resource

General IT Operations

  • Assist with procurement requests through the Nerdio Procurement Portal
  • Contribute to IT documentation, runbooks, and process improvements
  • Participate in IT projects such as infrastructure upgrades, tool rollouts, and policy improvements
  • Evaluate new AI tools for IT operations, pilot them with the team, and help document best practices for adoption (e.g., Zendesk AI features, Nerdio Scribe, etc.)
  • Use AI tools and automation to reduce manual work and improve ticket resolution times.

Required Qualifications

  • 5 or more years of experience in IT support, systems administration, or a related technical role
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID — including user and group management, Conditional Access, MFA, and hybrid identity
  • Familiarity with on-premises Active Directory and experience supporting Entra Connect Sync or equivalent AD sync tooling
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Intune — device enrollment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and app management
  • Experience administering Microsoft 365 workloads (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP)
  • Strong communication skills — able to clearly explain technical issues to non-technical users
  • Self-directed and comfortable working in a remote-first environment with minimal supervision
  • Ability to manage multiple tickets and competing priorities simultaneously while maintaining high service quality and consistent follow-through

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Nerdio Manager for MSP or Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environments
  • Familiarity with Zendesk or similar ITSM/ticketing platforms
  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., AZ-900, MD-102, AZ-104, AZ-140) are a strong plus
  • Experience supporting a globally distributed, remote-first workforce
  • PowerShell or Python scripting for automation and administrative tasks
  • Exposure to Azure fundamentals and cloud infrastructure concepts

What We Offer

  • A collaborative, technically strong Internal IT team where your work directly matters
  • Exposure to a modern, cloud-first Microsoft stack in a company that builds on top of it
  • Opportunities to grow into senior technical roles as the team expands
  • Remote-first flexibility with a supportive, global team culture
  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience and local market; benefits package in line with local employment law requirements
  • Nerdio complies with all applicable employment regulations in the countries where we hire. Specific employment terms, benefits, and statutory entitlements will be discussed during the offer stage based on your country of residence.

Benefits and Incentives

  • Health and Welfare Plans*

  • Unlimited Flexible Paid Time Off, including your birthday off!

* Benefits for international employees, outside the US, vary by country.

Being part of Remote People means being part of a growing, international family.

Position Overview:

As an Onboarding Specialist at RemotePeople, you will be a trusted partner to our clients as they hire talent around the world. You will guide clients and their new employees through every step of the onboarding journey, making international employment feel simple, clear, and well supported from day one.

You will manage multiple onboarding cases at the same time, reviewing employee information and documentation with great attention to detail, preparing employment contracts, and coordinating amendments when needed. You will also coordinate medical check-ups where required and partner with internal teams to ensure payroll and benefits are set up on time. jobs.description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit.

About the project

Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result.

About the roles

There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience& skillsets.

  • Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.

  • Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.

Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. Sabre Payments is transforming the way the travel industry manages and processes payments. Combining innovative payment technology with deep expertise in travel, we provide travel companies with an integrated payments ecosystem designed to simplify payment operations, improve efficiency and maximise the value of every transaction.

Our platform enables travel businesses to pay and get paid globally through a network of more than 70 issuers and a broad range of acquiring, payment and financial technology partners. Our solutions include virtual cards, issuing, acquiring, fraud and chargeback management, foreign exchange and cross-border payment capabilities.

By combining our global payment network, technology and travel industry expertise, we help travel businesses optimise their end-to-end payment strategy, reduce complexity and unlock new commercial opportunities.

Join us as we continue to build and expand our global payments business.


Role and Responsibilities


As Senior Sales Manager, EMEA – Sabre Payments, you will be responsible for driving commercial growth across the EMEA region, with a particular focus on acquiring new SME travel agency customers.

You will identify, develop and convert new business opportunities, positioning Sabre Payments as a strategic payments partner for travel agencies looking to improve their payment processes, access competitive payment solutions and grow their businesses.

This is a commercially driven, hands-on sales role requiring strong prospecting, relationship-building, negotiation and closing capabilities. You will own the sales process from initial engagement through contract signature and successful customer onboarding, working closely with internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.

  • Own the full sales lifecycle: Manage opportunities from prospecting and initial engagement through solution positioning, commercial negotiations, contracting, implementation and customer activation.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

Who are we?

A world where complexity is the only constant demands a new breed of company. Brave Bison is a different beast: a media, marketing and technology company purpose built for the digital era.

Our universe is made up of award-winning business arms Brave Bison, Engage, SocialChain and MTM. And we’re underpinned by leading marketing training practice, MiniMBA, as well as our very own social-first media network who deliver monthly views in the billions for some of the biggest channels in sport and entertainment across YouTube, Snap, Meta and TikTok.

We’re a global collective who live and breathe digital, working with some of the boldest brands in the world to capitalise on the complexity that defines the modern marketing landscape.

Our mission

New platforms, new behaviours, new audiences, new trends, new technologies, new regulations—our clients’ worlds get more complex daily. Their agency partnerships shouldn’t. It’s our job to cut through the chaos, make the complex simple and navigate a clear path to growth for them.

That’s why we make it our mission to capitalise on complexity for our clients—across consultancy, capability and execution—by crafting dynamic digital solutions that outpace tomorrow’s challenges.

Our values

We’re a proudly diverse business comprised of deep specialists across social media, digital marketing and technology. Although our skills, backgrounds and beliefs may differ, we are united by four core shared values:

  • Bold Curiosity.

We run at change and challenge convention because we love to push the boundaries of what the world thinks is possible. We champion discovery, go deep into our clients’ worlds and are always hungry to learn more about them, our specialisms and each other.

  • Connected Clarity.

We are focused in our collaboration — joining the right dots between our clients, our partners and our herd of experts to deliver agile solutions at speed and scale. We set a shared ambition from the outset, are transparent at every stage and always strive to make the complex simple.

  • Positive Encouragement.

We want to make working with us the best part of someone’s day. We lift one other up, find the fun in the day to day and are committed to ensuring everyone belongs.

  • Constant Impact.

We believe in outcomes over outputs. We’re goal orientated, results driven and data led. We show up with passion every day. And we’re always honing our craft.

Brave Bison Commerce

With over 300 ecommerce projects and £2billion worth of transactions under our belt, we’ve designed and built hundreds of bespoke digital solutions for complex B2B, B2C, D2C and B2B2C companies.

Whether we’re modernising a monolith platform or building a fully composable solution, we ensure our clients are ready to meet customers anywhere – online, mobile, in-store or on social – unlocking a brave new world of possibility.

Job Specification

We are looking for a Technical Lead with deep expertise in PHP, Laravel and Adobe Commerce (Magento) to join Brave Bison Commerce. You will set the technical direction on client projects and lead the engineers who deliver them. This is a client-facing role: you will run discovery work, explain technical decisions to stakeholders at every level and confidently recommend improvements and upgrades that help our clients get more from their platforms. If you enjoy hands-on engineering as much as shaping solutions with clients, we would love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical leadership

  • Lead and mentor a team of PHP developers, setting coding standards, reviewing code and supporting their professional growth.
  • Own the technical design of Adobe Commerce and Laravel solutions, from architecture and integrations through to deployment.
  • Stay hands-on, writing high-quality code and stepping into complex problems where your experience makes the biggest difference.
  • Plan and estimate technical work with project managers, keeping delivery on track and raising risks early.
  • Champion good engineering practice, including automated testing, CI/CD, performance optimisation and security.
  • Oversee platform upgrades, patching and migrations, including Magento 2 version upgrades and third-party extension management.

Clients and growth

  • Act as the senior technical point of contact for clients, joining calls and workshops and building trusted relationships.
  • Lead technical discoveries: auditing existing platforms, gathering requirements and turning them into clear solution designs, estimates and roadmaps.
  • Identify opportunities to improve clients’ platforms, such as upgrades, performance work, new features or integrations, and present them as well-reasoned recommendations and proposals.
  • Work with account and sales teams to scope and support upsell opportunities and new business pitches.
  • Translate complex technical topics into plain language for non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications:

  • Significant commercial experience as a PHP developer (typically 7+ years), including time in a lead or senior role.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with Adobe Commerce / Magento 2, including custom module development, theming, checkout, performance tuning and upgrades.
  • Strong Laravel experience, including building APIs, services and standalone applications that integrate with ecommerce platforms.
  • Experience integrating ecommerce platforms with third-party systems such as ERP, PIM, OMS, payment gateways and search.
  • Proven experience leading development teams, including code review, mentoring and technical planning.
  • Confidence in client-facing situations, with experience running discovery sessions, workshops or technical presentations.
  • A commercial mindset, with the ability to spot improvements and upgrades and clearly explain their value to clients.
  • Solid working knowledge of MySQL, Git, Composer and cloud or hosting environments (for example Adobe Commerce Cloud or AWS).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Power BI experience, for example building reports or dashboards.
  • Adobe Commerce developer or architect certifications.
  • Experience with Hyvä Themes or headless and composable frontends.
  • Agency or consultancy experience working across multiple clients.
  • Familiarity with other ecommerce platforms such as Shopify Plus or BigCommerce.

Finally, we’re proud and committed to being an equal opportunity workplace, providing equal opportunities for all and treating all existing employees and all job applicants in the same way, regardless of their age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity status and marital & civil partnership status

About the Role

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to support our Marketing Department with a variety of design projects.

You will create visual assets for marketing campaigns, brand communications, digital channels, websites, and company events. We are looking for someone with a strong eye for design who can turn ideas and briefs into polished, consistent visuals while following brand guidelines and bringing fresh creative ideas.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create visual assets for marketing campaigns, product announcements, social media and brand communications.

  • Design banners, promotional graphics, presentations and other commercial materials.

  • Create and update website visuals and other digital marketing materials.

  • Design materials for company events, conferences and trade shows.

  • Adapt designs to different platforms and formats while maintaining visual consistency.

  • Collaborate with the Marketing Department on creative briefs, concepts, feedback and deadlines.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years of professional graphic design experience.

  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Photoshop is essential.

  • Experience with other design tools such as Illustrator, InDesign, Figma or Canva.

  • Previous experience working with B2B, SaaS or tech companies.

  • A strong portfolio showcasing graphic design, branding and marketing materials.

  • Good understanding of typography, layout, composition, color and visual hierarchy.

  • Familiarity with social media formats and requirements.

  • Familiarity with AI tools and how they can support design workflows.

  • Strong attention to detail, creativity and the ability to maintain consistent brand standards.

Additional Beneficial Skills

This is a freelance opportunity involving various design projects over an expected period of 6 months, with the possibility of extension. The workload is variable, up to about 20 hours per week, depending on project needs.

At Tugi Tark, we believe in creating an environment where innovation thrives and your contributions make a real impact.

Please include your portfolio or a link to your portfolio with your application. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

We look forward to seeing your work!

Locations

Our story

The world’s innovators, designers, engineers, builders and creators trust Autodesk to help them design and make a better world for all.


Autodesk’s Design and Make Platform empowers customers to transform how they work through cloud-connected technology, automation, AI, data and insights. From the buildings and infrastructure around us to the products we use and the entertainment that inspires us, Autodesk technology helps our customers design and make the world around us.


Our customers are navigating significant change, including sustainability pressures, labor and supply-chain challenges, rapid technological advancement and increasing digital complexity. Global Expansion Sales helps them unlock greater value from Autodesk by uncovering new opportunities, expanding adoption and connecting Autodesk solutions to their most important business priorities.


Position Overview

As an Account Executive in Global Expansion Sales, you will own growth across an assigned portfolio of Autodesk customers.


This is a proactive expansion role with a strong hunter mindset. You will identify whitespace, self-generate qualified pipeline, build relationships with new buyers and expand Autodesk into additional teams, workflows, use cases and solution areas across your portfolio.


You will combine account insight, data and sales signals to prioritize where you spend your time, balancing disciplined portfolio coverage with the ability to create and progress meaningful six-figure commercial opportunities.

Success will be measured through expansion revenue, qualified pipeline creation, customer penetration, conversion of whitespace, sales execution and forecast accuracy.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute an expansion strategy across your assigned portfolio of named customers.
  • Proactively identify whitespace across users, teams, workflows, business priorities and Autodesk solution areas.
  • Self-generate qualified pipeline through consistent prospecting and opportunity creation within existing customer relationships.
  • Establish relationships with new contacts, influencers, decision-makers and buying centers.
  • Use customer data, market insight, product signals and business events to prioritize accounts and opportunities.
  • Use CRM, intent data, account intelligence and AI-enabled sales tools responsibly to prioritize customers, deepen research and improve sales preparation and execution.
  • Discover new use cases and connect Autodesk capabilities to meaningful customer business outcomes.
  • Create, progress and close six-figure opportunities through strong discovery, qualification, value selling and commercial execution.
  • Drive cross-sell, upsell and competitive displacement opportunities.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from discovery through negotiation and close, maintaining pace across multiple concurrent opportunities.
  • Create compelling value propositions and business cases appropriate to the customer opportunity.
  • Collaborate with Technical Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partners and other Autodesk teams to accelerate growth.
  • Maintain disciplined Salesforce practices, healthy pipeline coverage and accurate forecasts.
  • Continuously learn from successful plays and apply those insights across the portfolio.

What Success Looks Like

Consistent achievement of expansion targets; healthy self-generated pipeline; increased penetration of Autodesk solutions; expansion into new buying centers, teams and workflows; successful creation and conversion of six-figure opportunities; competitive wins; strong CRM discipline; and accurate forecasting.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Demonstrated success in quota-carrying B2B technology, SaaS, cloud or enterprise software sales.
  • Proven ability to prospect and create pipeline rather than relying solely on inbound opportunities.
  • Experience identifying and closing expansion, cross-sell or upsell opportunities within named accounts.
  • Experience progressing meaningful six-figure software, SaaS or technology opportunities, or comparable commercial complexity.
  • Strong discovery, qualification, value-selling, negotiation and closing skills.
  • Ability to prioritize effectively across a broad named-account portfolio and manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
  • Strong commercial judgment and ability to create urgency appropriately.
  • Demonstrated fluency with CRM, pipeline management, account intelligence and sales productivity tools. Experience with Salesforce, Clari, 6sense, ZoomInfo or comparable platforms is valued.
  • Strong written, verbal and virtual customer-engagement skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across a matrixed organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling within Autodesk’s Design and Make industries.
  • Experience with named-account or digitally enabled enterprise selling.
  • Experience with value-based or consultative sales methodologies.
  • Experience competing for and displacing incumbent technology.

How we work at Autodesk

At Autodesk, we work as One Autodesk and bring our One ORBIT values to life every day: Optimistic, Relentless, Brave, Ingenious and Trusted. In this role, that means collaborating across Autodesk, creating growth with urgency and building trusted customer relationships.

Learn More

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

The function covers CFTC swap data reporting under Part 45, EU transaction reporting under MiFIR, EU derivatives reporting under EMIR, UK MiFIR and UK EMIR, and ASIC derivative transaction reporting across multiple OKX entities and a growing derivatives product set. These regimes have different scopes, reporting parties, data requirements and destinations. You will determine how they apply to OKX’s activities and help build a reliable process for meeting each obligation.
Most of the work is data and judgment: deciding what is reportable, by which entity, and to whom, then making sure the right trade and lifecycle data reaches the right swap data repository, trade repository, or regulator on time and reconciles to our trading records. You will own reporting scoping/eligibility, submission monitoring, and the controls that show our reports are complete, accurate, and timely.
This is a hands-on Compliance leadership role. You will work with Trading, Product, Engineering, Data, Legal, local Compliance teams and reporting providers, and you will lead regulatory change in this space. Responsibilities for source data, systems, submissions and remediation will be agreed across those teams; you will lead the compliance framework and stay close enough to the process to identify and proactively resolve problems. You will report to the Head of Markets and Product Compliance and support a central function that owns reporting interpretation, scoping, oversight, and remediation for every entity in scope.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Interpret and apply derivatives and transaction reporting rules across global regimes, including CFTC Part 45, MiFIR Article 26, EMIR Article 9, UK MiFIR, UK EMIR, and the ASIC Derivative Transaction Rules (Reporting) 2024, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and outside counsel.
  • Own and maintain entity, product, and transaction-level reporting scoping and eligibility: which entity reports, which products and lifecycle events are in scope, which counterparty role triggers the obligation, and which repository or authority receives the report.
  • Oversee, support, and help maintain the daily reporting process. Monitor submissions against deadlines, including T+1 for MiFIR transaction reports, investigate rejections and breaks, and track each one to resolution.
  • Reconcile reported activity to trading records and repository data, and coordinate corrections and back-reporting with the teams that own the relevant systems and data.
  • Define and maintain the reporting data specification with Engineering and Data, including field-level mapping, reference data such as LEIs, UTIs, UPIs, and ISINs, and the validation rules applied before submission.
  • Build and run the control framework: completeness, accuracy, and timeliness checks, exception management, management information, and records that hold up to regulator and audit review.
  • Drive reporting readiness and remediation. Assess new derivatives products, new entities, and regulatory changes, identify control gaps, agree on owners and deadlines across Compliance, Operations, Product, and Engineering, and track delivery.
  • Escalate material issues. Assess the impact of reporting errors, escalate to senior management, and support notifications to regulators where required.
  • Manage relationships with swap data repositories, trade repositories, approved reporting mechanisms, and reporting vendors, including onboarding, testing, and service issues.
  • Hands-on leader. Build a small team, and coordinate with and train local compliance leads.
  • Support independent testing by Compliance Monitoring, Risk, and Internal Audit, and support regulator inquiries with complete, reproducible records.

What We Look For In You

  • A degree in finance, economics, law, data science, or computer science, or an equivalent professional qualification
  • 7+ years in trade reporting, transaction reporting, or regulatory reporting at an exchange, broker, bank, trading firm, fintech, or digital asset platform
  • Deep working knowledge of at least two of the following regimes: CFTC swap data reporting, MiFIR transaction reporting, EMIR, UK MiFIR, UK EMIR, and ASIC derivative transaction reporting. Hands-on experience with both a US and a European regime is strongly preferred.
  • A sound understanding of derivatives trade lifecycles and the data needed to report executions, changes, terminations and, where applicable, valuations and collateral.
  • The ability to interrogate large datasets, investigate reporting breaks and explain clear requirements to engineers and other business partners. SQL or comparable data analysis skills are highly desirable.
  • Experience building or improving a reporting framework, including procedures, reconciliations, exception management and evidence that can withstand regulatory or audit scrutiny; this may include remediating historical reporting errors, including back-reporting.
  • The judgment to make proportionate risk decisions, escalate material issues and lead delivery across teams without relying on a single team to own every part of the reporting process.
  • Experience with digital asset derivatives, such as perpetual futures and options, and how they map to reporting product classifications

Nice to Haves

  • Experience leading a regulatory reporting change program, such as EMIR Refit, UK EMIR Refit, the CFTC reporting rewrite, or the ASIC 2024 rules.
  • Familiarity with ISO 20022 XML reporting formats.
  • Python or similar scripting for data validation, and experience with data warehouse tools such as Databricks.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

  • Find the gaps in a spec before you build. Close the small ones yourself and bring only business questions to the Product Owner.

  • Use AI tools across the whole lifecycle: planning, design, build, testing, review and maintenance. Keep the human judgement on correctness, security and data protection.

  • Own quality: unit and integration tests, code review, and non-functional requirements (performance, security, observability) as part of the design.

  • Follow features into production: watch telemetry and usage, support releases, investigate incidents and close the loop with the product team.

  • Contribute to architecture discussions and decision records with the Tech Lead and architects and help pay down tech debt in the sales flows.

  • Make the team better at AI: mentor engineers and share the instructions, checks and small tools that work.

Product Mindset

As AI takes on more of the typing, the value of an engineer moves to judgement: knowing what to build, why, and what good looks like for the user. In this role you:

  • Start every feature with the business question: who in the clinic uses it, and what problem it solves for them.

  • Push back with alternatives when a request is expensive and a simpler solution gives most of the value.

  • Explain technical trade-offs in business terms to Product Owners, delivery and customer-facing colleagues.

  • Look at usage, support tickets and customer feedback after release, and feed what you learn into the next iteration.

IF YOU ARE

  • Typically 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of building and running production systems. We value practical experience and demonstrated capabilities over years alone.

  • Strong hands-on experience with C# and modern .NET, including:

    • Core and Web APIs.

    • Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core.

    • Clean Architecture and maintainable application design.

  • Solid frontend development experience using React and TypeScript, particularly for complex business applications.

  • Practical experience designing and developing microservices architectures.

  • Understanding of asynchronous communication and event-driven systems, ideally using:

    • Azure Service Bus.

    • MassTransit.

    • Similar messaging and event-processing technologies.

  • Strong SQL database experience, including relational data modelling and transactional business data.

  • Experience with API design, automated testing, debugging, and security fundamentals.

  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents as part of everyday development, such as:

    • Ability to demonstrate practical AI-assisted development workflows, including examples of reviewing AI-generated code, identifying mistakes, and understanding when AI should not be used.

    • Strong product mindset, with examples of contributing to feature definition, understanding business needs, and influencing technical and product decisions.

    • Good command of English (B2 or above), both written and spoken.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Python for AI tooling, evaluations and prototypes.

  • Features built on LLM APIs: prompting, tool use, and measuring the quality of the results.

  • Experience in regulated domains (medical devices, healthcare, finance) or with sensitive personal data.

  • AKS / Kubernetes.

  • You have built or improved developer tooling, CI/CD or AI agent setups that other engineers use.

AS AN OPINOV8R, YOU WILL HAVE

  • Digital-First Approach:Great talent knows no borders! You can work from wherever you are — we hire and collaborate with professionals worldwide.

  • Remote Work Model:Balance your professional and personal life with our flexible working conditions, empowering you to deliver your best from anywhere.

  • Boost Your Expertise:Grow your career with continuous learning, development opportunities, and hands-on experience.

HOW’S THE HIRING PROCESS GOING

We strive to make our hiring process smooth and transparent to find the perfect match for both sides. Steps may differ depending on the role, but here’s what to expect:

jobs.title: Head of Service Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Cincom is bringing Level 1 support, hosting support and infrastructure together into one 24/7 Service Operations function, reporting directly to the COO. It covers all of our main product lines, including CPQ, Eloquence, Cincom Smalltalk, Mantis, Supra and Control, along with the customer environments we host and manage and the infrastructure they run on.

Today, these areas work differently from one product to the next. Processes, tools and standards vary in many cases, and too much depends on a few people who know a product or a platform inside out. We want one modern, professional operation that runs around the clock and that customers experience the same way, whichever product they use and wherever/however it is deployed.

We are looking for someone to build this team and lead it. You will set the operating model, lead the three teams, own escalations through to resolution, and put the tooling, processes and measures in place to run Service Operations as a true 24/7 managed service. You will sit on the COO’s leadership team and take on wider operational responsibility as the function matures. It is a senior leadership role, but you will need to stay close enough to the work to know what good looks like and to step in when it counts.

WHY THIS ROLE

This is a new function with a direct line to the COO. You will shape it from the start, with real backing to change how we work and a clear mandate to build a professional service that customers value. It is also a role with room to grow: as the function matures, we expect you to take on wider operational responsibility across the business.

The role is remote and the location is open. Because Service Operations runs 24/7, you will take part in senior escalation cover for major incidents, and potentially travel occasionally to meet the team and customers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Leadership & People Management

  • Lead the three teams that report to you, specifically, Level 1 Support, Hosting Support and Infrastructure Management, and build and retain Level 2 knowledge over time.
  • Build out the Level 1 team, starting with a new team being established, and make sure it works hand in hand with our existing product support specialists in the Cincom business.
  • Hire, develop and coach the team, and cross-skill people across products and platforms so we are not reliant on any one person.
  • Set clear objectives, give regular feedback, and build a team that takes ownership of the customer’s problem.

Operational Leadership

  • Sit on the COO’s leadership team and contribute to decisions across engineering, delivery and operations.
  • Deputise for the COO on operational matters when needed, and take on wider operational responsibility as the function matures.
  • Own the Service Operations budget, including hosting and infrastructure costs, and help deliver against the business’s cost and efficiency targets.
  • Manage key operational suppliers and contracts, working with the COO and PartnerOne Group procurement and IT where Group agreements apply.

Building a 24/7 Service Operations Function

  • Design and run Service Operations as a true 24/7 service, with coverage, rotas and on-call arrangements that match our customer commitments.
  • Build out-of-hours models that make good use of the team, without burning people out.
  • Replace product-by-product ways of working with one consistent model for intake, triage, severity and prioritisation.
  • Bring in modern support practice, including ITIL-aligned incident, problem and change management and knowledge-centred support.
  • Build a proper Managed Services approach for our hosted platforms, working across the Hosting Support and Infrastructure teams and with the Client Success Team for our key accounts.

Escalation Management to Level 2 and 3

  • Own the escalation process from Level 1 into Level 2/3: product engineering teams for product issues, and Services consultants for issues in project deliverables, where necessary.
  • Set clear criteria for when and how issues escalate, so they arrive with the right information, and nothing gets lost in the handover.
  • Track every escalated issue through to resolution, keep customers informed, chase when timescales slip.
  • Review escalation trends with the product heads, push recurring issues back for permanent fixes and inclusion in roadmaps and make sure what we learn is captured in the smart knowledge base.

Hosting Support

  • Hold overall accountability for the customer environments Cincom hosts and manages, delivered through the Hosting Support team, and stay engaged with customer hosted deployments and associated metrics.
  • Make sure hosted services meet their commitments on availability, monitoring, backups, patching, disaster recovery and incident response, around the clock, providing a true Managed Service.
  • Turn hosting into a consistent, repeatable managed service that our commercial team can understand and sell with confidence.

Infrastructure

  • Lead the Infrastructure team and own the hardware and deployment design for hosted and on-premise customer environments. Software design stays with the product engineering teams.
  • Set infrastructure standards and reference architectures for each product, covering capacity, resilience, security and cost.
  • Plan capacity and sizing with the product and project delivery teams, so customer environments are built right first time.
  • Keep our cloud and infrastructure estate, including Azure and Kubernetes, secure, patched, documented and cost-effective.

Tooling, Automation & AI

  • Make Zoho Desk the single platform for support, configured properly and used consistently across every product, with integrations into other Cincom operational platforms as required.
  • Build and maintain a knowledge base (working with Cincom designated AI tools) that customers and the team actually use and expand self-service and automation where it saves everyone effort.
  • Work with our AI team to explore and develop AI-assisted Level 1 support, including local-language support, with validation before answers reach customers.

Performance, Reporting & Compliance

  • Set and track SLAs and internal service levels for response and resolution, by severity.
  • Report on ticket trends by product, customer, region, severity and SLA tracked resolution time, alongside hosting availability and infrastructure cost, not just ticket status, and review them monthly with the COO.
  • Lead the response to major incidents, with clear and timely communication to customers following a well-documented process.
  • Make sure support, hosting and infrastructure processes provide the evidence we need for ISO 27001 and SOC 2, and support our obligations to customers in regulated sectors.

Requirements

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essential Experience

  • Experience leading support, hosting or infrastructure operations for enterprise software customers, ideally across more than one product.
  • Experience leading several teams through team leads, at senior management level.
  • A track record of building or reshaping a support or operations function, not only running an existing one.
  • Experience running or building a 24/7 support operation, including on-call and potential follow-the-sun models.
  • Experience managing escalations into engineering teams and holding them to agreed timescales.
  • Experience running SLA-based support for business-critical customer systems.
  • Experience owning an operational budget, including hosting and infrastructure costs.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong grounding in incident, problem and change management (ITIL or equivalent).
  • Solid understanding of hosted and cloud infrastructure, Azure or similar, including monitoring and alerting, high availability, backup and disaster recovery, and management of guaranteed up-time.
  • Familiarity with containerised deployments such as Kubernetes, and with infrastructure-as-code.
  • Comfortable with service desk platforms, reporting and automation.

Leadership & Interpersonal Skills

  • Calm and clear with customers and senior colleagues, especially when things go wrong.
  • Uses data to manage performance and to make the case for change.
  • Builds trust across Engineering, Delivery and Client Success, and gets things done without relying on authority.
  • Thinks beyond their own function, and is comfortable representing operations at leadership and Group level.
  • Fluent Business English communication.

Desirable

  • Hands-on experience with Zoho Desk or a comparable service desk platform.
  • Experience introducing AI-assisted support, knowledge-centred support or self-service.
  • ITIL 4 certification.
  • Additional languages, particularly French, German, Italian.
  • Experience supporting customers in regulated sectors such as financial services and insurance, and familiarity with ISO 27001 and SOC 2.
  • Experience with cloud cost management or FinOps practices.

Benefits

  • Independent Contractor (Contractor is responsible for applicable taxes and statutory obligations, subject to the agreement and local law)
  • Full-time role
  • Availability for occasional short travels
  • Payment in USD
  • Equipment provided by the company
  • Contractor fee range - $3,900–$6,000 USD per month

Equal Opportunity Employer

PartnerOne is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

AI Use Disclosure

During our recruitment process, we may use technology, including AI-assisted tools, to support application review or scheduling. These tools support our recruiting team and do not replace human decision-making. Where required, candidates will receive additional information about the tool and applicable rights.

jobs.title: 🇩🇪 Product Engineer / Entwickler (100% Remote) – Deutsch fließend
jobs.description:
In den meisten Firmen bekommt ein Entwickler ein Ticket, baut es und nimmt sich das nächste. Mit dem Kunden hat jemand anderes geredet, was gebaut wird, hat jemand anderes entschieden, und ob es am Ende geholfen hat, fragt keiner.

Wir suchen Entwickler, die die ganze Arbeit machen wollen: mit den Leuten reden, die die Software nutzen, entscheiden, was gebaut wird, es bauen und dranbleiben, bis es für sie funktioniert. Das meinen wir mit Product Engineer. Den Begriff haben wir von PostHog, die ihn in ihrem Product Engineer Handbook gut beschreiben.

Unsere Kunden sind Hausverwaltungen in Deutschland. Du sprichst direkt mit ihnen, deshalb ist fließendes Deutsch für diese Stelle Pflicht.

Über uns

ist Software für Hausverwaltungen in Deutschland. Inbox, CRM, Dokumente, Telefonie, Videocalls, Team-Chat und KI-Agenten in einer Plattform, damit Hausverwalter ihre tägliche Arbeit an einem Ort erledigen. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit Sitz in Worms und arbeiten komplett remote. Wir finanzieren uns selbst und sind profitabel.

Was ein Product Engineer bei uns macht

  • Du redest mit Kunden. Du liest die Supportanfragen und das Feedback zu deinem Bereich, schaust dir an, wie Kunden ihn nutzen, und sprichst direkt mit ihnen, auf Deutsch. Niemand filtert das für dich.

  • Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird. Für deinen Bereich legst du fest, was als Nächstes kommt, nach dem, was Kunden brauchen und was für die Firma wichtig ist. Du schreibst auf, warum, damit das Team folgen und Feedback geben kann.

  • Du lieferst früh. Die erste Version geht an ein paar Kunden, sobald sie nützlich ist. Dann verbesserst du sie nach dem, was sie sagen und tun.

  • Du baust alles. Datenmodell, Backend, Frontend und UI. Das Ergebnis muss aufgeräumt, einfach und verständlich sein, nicht nur funktionieren.

  • Du machst den Support für deinen Bereich. Wenn etwas kaputt ist oder ein Kunde nicht weiterkommt, behebst du es und sagst ihm Bescheid.

  • Du prüfst, ob es funktioniert hat. Deine Arbeit ist nicht fertig, wenn das Feature live ist. Du schaust, ob Kunden es nutzen und ob es ihr Problem gelöst hat.

  • Du automatisierst, was geht. Wenn ein Kunde eine Supportfrage stellt, trägst du die Antwort in unsere Wissensdatenbank ein und passt unseren internen Agenten an, damit es beim nächsten Mal von selbst läuft. Vieles läuft bei uns schon automatisch, Bugfixes werden bereits halbautomatisch bearbeitet, und wir automatisieren weiter.

Beispiele, woran du arbeiten könntest

  • Ein Kunde will seine alte Dateiablage in unsere Dokumentenverwaltung holen, mit eigener Ordnerstruktur und tausenden Dokumenten, schnell und mit KI-Unterstützung. Du schaust dir an, wie er seine Dateien sortiert hat, baust den Import als allgemeines Feature für alle Kunden, richtest ihn für ihn ein und testest ihn mit seiner Ordnerstruktur. Danach prüfst du, ob die KI jedes Dokument dem richtigen Gebäude, der richtigen Wohnung oder dem richtigen Kontakt zugeordnet hat, und korrigierst, was nicht passt.

  • Ein Kunde meldet, dass der Inbox-Agent einem Mieter eine falsche Antwort gegeben hat. Du schaust dir an, was der Agent gemacht hat, korrigierst das Tool oder seine Anweisungen und gibst dem Kunden Bescheid.

  • Nur wenige Kunden bauen eigene Agenten in der Sandbox. Du findest heraus, warum, über die Daten und Gespräche mit Kunden, machst die Einrichtung einfacher und prüfst, ob danach mehr Kunden sie nutzen.

  • Hausverwalter machen dieselbe Aufgabe fünfzigmal am Tag und brauchen dafür zu viele Klicks. Du merkst das, redest mit ihnen darüber, wie sie arbeiten, und machst es schneller.

Unser Tech-Stack

Alles ist TypeScript, vom Datenbankschema bis zum Frontend.

Backend: Convex (Datenbank & Serverless Functions)

Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui

Agenten: Vercel AI SDK, LiveKit für Telefonie

Du baust mit Claude und bekommst so viele KI-Tokens, wie du brauchst.

Gehalt

  • 1.500 – 3.000 $ pro Monat brutto, mit Luft nach oben in den nächsten Monaten und Jahren

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag in deinem Wohnland über unseren Partner Deel (EOR)

Benefits

  • 100 % remote

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Selbst finanziert und profitabel, kein Investorengeld, das verbrannt werden muss

  • Kleines Team, was du baust, geht live

  • Schnelle Entscheidungen, keine unnötigen Meetings und keine Freigabeschleifen

Unser Gesundheitsprogramm

  • Einzelzimmer im Krankenhaus, weltweiter Schutz

  • Freie Arzt- und Facharztwahl, keine Gesundheitsprüfung, Vorerkrankungen spielen keine Rolle

  • Partner und Kinder sind mitversichert

  • Operationen, Krebsbehandlung, MRT/CT/PET und Diagnostik voll abgedeckt

  • Zahnbehandlung und Zahn-OP zu 90 % abgedeckt

  • 675 $ pro Jahr für Physiotherapie, Osteopathie, Chiropraktik und Akupunktur

  • 100 $ Krankenhaustagegeld pro Nacht, bis zu 20 Nächte

  • Medikamente, Impfungen, Brillen/Kontaktlinsen, häusliche Pflege und Krankentransport abgedeckt

Unsere Grundprinzipien

  • Speed of Implementation: Wir setzen schnell um. Eine erste Version geht früh live und wird mit dem Feedback der Kunden besser.

  • Radikale Ehrlichkeit: Wir sagen offen, was ist, im Team und gegenüber unseren Kunden. Gerade dann, wenn es unangenehm ist.

  • Hohe Ansprüche an die eigene Arbeit und an die der anderen

Requirements

Voraussetzungen

  • Fließendes Deutsch (mindestens C1), du kannst mit Kunden telefonieren und schreiben

  • Gutes Englisch

  • Mehr als ein Jahr Erfahrung mit Code, der produktiv im Einsatz ist

Worauf wir achten

  • Dir ist wichtiger, dass Kunden ihre Arbeit erledigt bekommen, als die perfekte Umsetzung.

  • Du hast ein gutes Auge für Gestaltung und UI. Du lieferst nicht einfach, was die KI erzeugt, sondern arbeitest an der Oberfläche, bis sie aufgeräumt und für die Nutzer so einfach und verständlich wie möglich ist.

  • Du machst Dinge fertig. Ein Feature, das zu 80 % fertig ist, hilft niemandem, deshalb bleibst du dran, bis es gut funktioniert.

  • Du hast eine Meinung dazu, was gebaut werden soll, und begründest sie mit dem, was Kunden sagen und tun. Wenn das Feedback etwas anderes sagt, änderst du deine Meinung.

  • Du nimmst Feedback gut an und gibst selbst ehrliches Feedback.

  • Du schreibst klar. Als Remote-Team arbeiten wir viel schriftlich: Issues, kurze Vorschläge, PR-Beschreibungen.

  • Du verstehst die Grundlagen des Geschäfts: wer unsere Kunden sind, wofür sie zahlen und warum sie bleiben.

  • Du schreibst fast deinen gesamten Code mit KI und verstehst Architektur gut genug, um zu beurteilen, was sie schreibt.

  • Du automatisierst eine Aufgabe lieber, als sie zweimal zu machen.

  • Du bist Generalist und lernst schnell Neues.

Schön zu haben

  • Du hast ein eigenes Produkt oder Nebenprojekt gebaut, das echte Menschen genutzt haben, oder schon direkt mit Kunden gearbeitet.

  • Erfahrung mit Datenbankdesign und der Optimierung von Abfragen nach Geschwindigkeit und Kosten

  • Erfahrung mit Agenten, Queues und lang laufenden Workflows im Produktivbetrieb

Die Stelle passt nicht zu dir, wenn

  • du willst, dass jemand anderes entscheidet, was du baust, und dir Tickets gibt

  • du lieber nichts mit Kunden oder Support zu tun haben willst

  • du Code wochenlang polieren willst, bevor ihn jemand sieht

  • du gern zur nächsten Idee springst, bevor die letzte wirklich funktioniert

So stellen wir ein

  1. Kennenlerngespräch

  2. Interview mit unserem Gründer über deinen Werdegang und das, was du gebaut hast

  3. Referenzgespräch mit einer früheren Führungskraft

  4. Angebot

Mehr über das, was wir bauen, siehst du auf unserem YouTube-Kanal.
